end.summary:
Practised showing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi identified 11 as ten and one more.
For 14, they counted one bundle and four loose sticks to reach fourteen.
They later mixed up saying “one bundle” with saying “one ten”; teach-back was not passed.
Lesson ended when Saanvi asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised building numbers with one bundle of ten and loose sticks. Counting on from ten helped them identify fourteen as ten and four more, but the naming of the bundle remained mixed up later in the lesson and was not corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, make a bundle of 10 straws and ask, “How many tens? How many ones?” before naming numbers such as 14.
